description: This file contains NgRx selectors for authentication state management in an Angular application, including functions to select specific slices of auth state and retrieve current auth-related data from the store.

methods.name: selectAuthState
methods.description: Creates a feature selector for the 'auth' slice of the application state.

methods.name: selectAuth
methods.description: Selector that returns the entire AuthState.

methods.name: selectIsAuthenticated
methods.description: Selector that returns the isAuthenticated boolean from AuthState.

methods.name: selectIsUserLoaded
methods.description: Selector that returns the isUserLoaded boolean from AuthState.

methods.name: selectUserReady
methods.description: Selector combining isAuthenticated and isUserLoaded into an object.

methods.name: selectAuthUser
methods.description: Selector that returns the authUser object from AuthState.

methods.name: selectUserDetails
methods.description: Selector that returns userDetails from AuthState.

methods.name: selectUserTokenAccessEnabled
methods.description: Selector that returns userTokenAccessEnabled from AuthState.

methods.name: selectHasRepository
methods.description: Selector that returns hasRepository from AuthState.

methods.name: selectTbelEnabled
methods.description: Selector that returns tbelEnabled from AuthState.

methods.name: selectPersistDeviceStateToTelemetry
methods.description: Selector that returns persistDeviceStateToTelemetry from AuthState.

methods.name: selectMobileQrEnabled
methods.description: Selector that returns mobileQrEnabled from AuthState.

methods.name: selectHomeDashboardParams
methods.description: Selector combining persistDeviceStateToTelemetry and mobileQrEnabled into an object.

methods.name: selectUserSettings
methods.description: Selector that returns userSettings from AuthState.

methods.name: selectUserSettingsProperty
methods.description: Parameterized selector that retrieves a nested property from userSettings.

methods.name: selectOpenedMenuSections
methods.description: Selector that returns openedMenuSections from userSettings.

methods.name: getCurrentAuthState
methods.description: Function to synchronously retrieve current AuthState from the store.

methods.name: getCurrentAuthUser
methods.description: Function to synchronously retrieve current AuthUser from the store.

methods.name: getCurrentUserSettings
methods.description: Function to synchronously retrieve current UserSettings from the store.

methods.name: getCurrentOpenedMenuSections
methods.description: Function to synchronously retrieve current opened menu sections from the store.
